exports.name: ForceNativeScrollDirective
exports.summary:
Marks an element (typically a scrollable child inside a `perfectScrollbar` container)
so Perfect Scrollbar lets it use native browser scrolling instead of intercepting it.
exports.summaryZh:
标记一个元素（通常是 `perfectScrollbar` 容器内的可滚动子元素），
使 Perfect Scrollbar 放行其原生浏览器滚动，而不是拦截处理。

exports.name: PerfectScrollbarComponent
exports.summary:
Component wrapper around {@link PerfectScrollbarDirective} that additionally renders
scroll-position indicator overlays and supports edge-propagation of wheel/touch scrolling.
exports.summaryZh:
{@link PerfectScrollbarDirective} 的组件版封装，额外渲染滚动位置指示条覆层，
并支持在到达边缘时向外传播滚轮/触摸滚动。

exports.name: PerfectScrollbarDirective
exports.summary:
Wraps the `perfect-scrollbar` library on the host element, providing custom scrollbars
and scroll event outputs (`psScrollY`, `psYReachEnd`, etc.).
exports.summaryZh:
在宿主元素上封装 `perfect-scrollbar` 库，提供自定义滚动条以及滚动事件输出
（`psScrollY`、`psYReachEnd` 等）。

methods.name: ps
methods.description: Returns the underlying `perfect-scrollbar` library instance, or `null` if not initialized.
methods.descriptionZh: 返回底层 `perfect-scrollbar` 库实例，未初始化时返回 `null`。

methods.name: update
methods.description: Recalculates the scrollbar geometry (debounced); call after content size changes.
methods.descriptionZh: 重新计算滚动条几何信息（带防抖）；在内容尺寸变化后调用。

methods.name: geometry
methods.description:
Returns the host element's current scroll position/size as a {@link Geometry}, using the
given DOM property prefix (`scroll`/`offset`/`client`).
methods.descriptionZh:
使用给定的 DOM 属性前缀（`scroll`/`offset`/`client`），
以 {@link Geometry} 形式返回宿主元素当前的滚动位置/尺寸。

methods.name: position
methods.description:
Returns the current scroll position, either relative to the scrollbar's "reach" state
or absolute (native `scrollLeft`/`scrollTop`) if `absolute` is `true`.
methods.descriptionZh:
返回当前滚动位置；默认相对于滚动条的"到达边缘"状态，`absolute` 为 `true` 时
返回绝对位置（原生 `scrollLeft`/`scrollTop`）。

methods.name: scrollable
methods.description:
Whether the host element is currently scrollable in the given direction
(`'any'`, `'both'`, `'x'`, or `'y'`).
methods.descriptionZh: 宿主元素当前在给定方向上是否可滚动（`'any'`、`'both'`、`'x'` 或 `'y'`）。

methods.name: scrollTo
methods.description:
Scrolls to the given `x`/`y` position, optionally animated over `speed` ms. If only `x` is
given, it's treated as a vertical (`scrollTop`) target.
methods.descriptionZh:
滚动到给定的 `x`/`y` 位置，可选地在 `speed` 毫秒内动画过渡。若只提供 `x`，
则视为垂直方向（`scrollTop`）目标。

methods.name: scrollToX
methods.description: Scrolls horizontally to the given `x` position, optionally animated over `speed` ms.
methods.descriptionZh: 水平滚动到给定的 `x` 位置，可选地在 `speed` 毫秒内动画过渡。

methods.name: scrollToY
methods.description: Scrolls vertically to the given `y` position, optionally animated over `speed` ms.
methods.descriptionZh: 垂直滚动到给定的 `y` 位置，可选地在 `speed` 毫秒内动画过渡。

methods.name: scrollToTop
methods.description: Scrolls to the top, offset by `offset` pixels, optionally animated over `speed` ms.
methods.descriptionZh: 滚动到顶部（可偏移 `offset` 像素），可选地在 `speed` 毫秒内动画过渡。

methods.name: scrollToLeft
methods.description: Scrolls to the left edge, offset by `offset` pixels, optionally animated over `speed` ms.
methods.descriptionZh: 滚动到左侧边缘（可偏移 `offset` 像素），可选地在 `speed` 毫秒内动画过渡。

methods.name: scrollToRight
methods.description: Scrolls to the right edge, offset by `offset` pixels, optionally animated over `speed` ms.
methods.descriptionZh: 滚动到右侧边缘（可偏移 `offset` 像素），可选地在 `speed` 毫秒内动画过渡。

methods.name: scrollToBottom
methods.description: Scrolls to the bottom edge, offset by `offset` pixels, optionally animated over `speed` ms.
methods.descriptionZh: 滚动到底部边缘（可偏移 `offset` 像素），可选地在 `speed` 毫秒内动画过渡。

methods.name: scrollToElement
methods.description:
Scrolls the given element (or CSS selector resolved within the host) into view,
offset by `offset` pixels, optionally animated over `speed` ms.
methods.descriptionZh:
将给定元素（或在宿主内解析的 CSS 选择器）滚动到可视区域内，
可偏移 `offset` 像素，可选地在 `speed` 毫秒内动画过渡。
